They're flying to London next week.
examples.ru: На следующей неделе они летят в Лондон.

exercises.explain_en: With 'I' we use 'am' + verb-ing.
exercises.explain_ru: С I используем am + глагол с -ing.

exercises.explain_en: With 'she' we use 'is' + verb-ing.
exercises.explain_ru: С she используем is + глагол с -ing.

exercises.explain_en: Just add -ing: playing.
exercises.explain_ru: Просто добавляем -ing: playing.

exercises.q: The present continuous is for actions happening now.
exercises.explain_en: Yes. 'I am reading' = right now.
exercises.explain_ru: Верно. I am reading — прямо сейчас.

exercises.q: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
exercises.explain_en: 'Look!' shows it is now, and 'children' is plural: are playing.
exercises.explain_ru: Look! показывает, что это сейчас; children — множественное число: are playing.

exercises.explain_en: Drop the -e and add -ing: writing.
exercises.explain_ru: Убираем -e и добавляем -ing: writing.

exercises.explain_en: We need -ing: I am working now.
exercises.explain_ru: Нужно окончание -ing: I am working now.

exercises.explain_en: Present continuous question: Are + you + -ing.
exercises.explain_ru: Вопрос в Present Continuous: Are + you + глагол с -ing.

exercises.explain_en: One vowel + one consonant: double the consonant: swimming.
exercises.explain_ru: Одна гласная + одна согласная: удваиваем согласную: swimming.

exercises.explain_en: Negative: am + not + -ing.
exercises.explain_ru: Отрицание: am + not + глагол с -ing.

exercises.q: 'I am wanting a coffee.' is correct.
exercises.explain_en: 'Want' is not used in the continuous: I want a coffee.
exercises.explain_ru: Want не используется в Present Continuous: I want a coffee.

exercises.q: I usually drink tea, but today I ___ coffee.
exercises.explain_en: 'Today' = now, a temporary action: present continuous.
exercises.explain_ru: Today — сейчас, временное действие: Present Continuous.

exercises.explain_en: Just add -ing: sleeping.
exercises.explain_ru: Просто добавляем -ing: sleeping.

exercises.explain_en: 'Every Sunday' = a habit: present simple.
exercises.explain_ru: Every Sunday — привычка: Present Simple.

exercises.q: The baby is ___ (lie) on the bed.
exercises.explain_en: Special spelling: lie → lying.

sections.title_en: Past simple: was / were and regular verbs
sections.title_ru: Прошедшее простое время: was / were и правильные глаголы
sections.summary_en: How to talk about yesterday: was / were, verbs with -ed, didn't and Did you ...?
sections.summary_ru: Как говорить о прошлом: was / were, глаголы с -ed, didn't и Did you ...?

rules.title_en: was / were: the past of 'to be'
rules.title_ru: was / were: прошедшее время глагола to be
rules.body_en: In the past, 'to be' has two forms. Use 'was' with I, he, she, it. Use 'were' with you, we, they. I was at home. They were at school. It was cold yesterday.
rules.body_ru: В прошедшем времени у глагола to be две формы: was — с I, he, she, it; were — с you, we, they. I was at home (Я был дома). They were at school (Они были в школе). It was cold yesterday (Вчера было холодно). Русское «был / была / были» всегда переводится was или were — и, как в настоящем, этот глагол нельзя пропускать.

examples.en: We were in London last year.
examples.ru: В прошлом году мы были в Лондоне.

rules.title_en: wasn't / weren't, Was he ...? Were you ...?
rules.title_ru: wasn't / weren't, Was he ...? Were you ...?
rules.body_en: Negative: wasn't (was not), weren't (were not): I wasn't at home. They weren't happy. Question: put was / were first: Was he at work? Were you tired? Short answers: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.
rules.body_ru: Отрицание: wasn't (= was not), weren't (= were not): I wasn't at home (Меня не было дома). They weren't happy. Вопрос: was / were ставим в начало: Was he at work? (Он был на работе?), Were you tired? Краткие ответы: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't. / Yes, they were. / No, they weren't. Всё как с am / is / are, только в прошедшем.

examples.ru: Вчера меня не было в школе.

examples.en: Were you at the party? — Yes, I was.
Was the film good? — No, it wasn't.

rules.body_en: The past of 'there is / there are' is 'there was / there were': There was a shop here. There were many people at the party. Negative: there wasn't / there weren't.
rules.body_ru: Прошедшее время от there is / there are — there was / there were: There was a shop here (Здесь был магазин). There were many people at the party (На вечеринке было много людей). Отрицание: there wasn't / there weren't. Вопрос: Was there ...? / Were there ...?

examples.en: There was a cat in the garden.

rules.body_en: Most verbs make the past with -ed: work → worked, play → played, watch → watched. The form is the same for all persons: I worked, she worked, they worked. No -s in the past.
rules.body_ru: Большинство глаголов образуют прошедшее время с окончанием -ed: work → worked, play → played, watch → watched, visit → visited. Форма одна для всех лиц: I worked, she worked, they worked — в отличие от русского «работал / работала / работали». В прошедшем времени никакого -s нет.

examples.en: I worked in a shop last year.
examples.ru: В прошлом году я работал в магазине.
В воскресенье они играли в футбол.

rules.body_en: Verbs ending in -e add only -d: live → lived, like → liked, dance → danced. Consonant + y: change y to -ied: study → studied, try → tried. Vowel + y: play → played. Short verbs with one vowel + one consonant double the consonant: stop → stopped, plan → planned.
rules.body_ru: Если глагол заканчивается на -e, добавляем только -d: live → lived, like → liked, dance → danced. Согласная + y: меняем -y на -ied: study → studied, try → tried, cry → cried. Гласная + y: просто -ed: play → played, stay → stayed. Короткие глаголы с одной гласной и одной согласной на конце удваивают согласную: stop → stopped, plan → planned, shop → shopped.

rules.body_en: Use 'didn't' (did not) + the verb without -ed: I didn't work yesterday. She didn't like the film. 'Didn't' is the same for all persons. Do not say 'didn't worked'.
rules.body_ru: Для отрицания используем didn't (= did not) + глагол в начальной форме, без -ed: I didn't work yesterday (Вчера я не работал). She didn't like the film. Didn't одинаков для всех лиц. Главная ошибка — «didn't worked»: окончание прошедшего времени уже есть в слове did, поэтому основной глагол остаётся без изменений.

examples.en: I didn't watch TV last night.
examples.ru: Вчера вечером я не смотрел телевизор.

examples.en: We didn't play tennis on Sunday.
examples.ru: В воскресенье мы не играли в теннис.

rules.body_en: Start with 'Did' + subject + verb without -ed: Did you work yesterday? Did she like it? Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, she didn't. Question words go first: Where did you live? What did he say?
rules.body_ru: Вопрос начинаем с Did + подлежащее + глагол без -ed: Did you work yesterday? (Ты вчера работал?), Did she like it? (Ей понравилось?). Краткие ответы: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. / Yes, she did. / No, she didn't. Вопросительные слова ставим в начало: Where did you live? (Где ты жил?), What did he say? (Что он сказал?). Как и с didn't, основной глагол без изменений.

examples.en: Did you visit your grandmother? — Yes, I did.
Did they play well? — No, they didn't.

rules.title_en: Time words: yesterday, last week, ago
rules.title_ru: Слова времени: yesterday, last week, ago
rules.body_en: The past simple goes with finished time: yesterday, last night, last week, last year, two days ago, in 2010, when I was a child. 'Ago' comes after the time: two days ago, a year ago.
rules.body_ru: Past Simple сочетается с указанием на законченное время: yesterday (вчера), last night (вчера вечером), last week (на прошлой неделе), last year (в прошлом году), two days ago (два дня назад), in 2010 (в 2010 году), when I was a child (когда я был ребёнком). Слово ago стоит после периода: two days ago, a year ago — порядок как в русском «два дня назад».

examples.en: I visited Rome two years ago.
examples.ru: Я был в Риме два года назад.

examples.en: We watched a film last night.

examples.ru: В 2015 году она жила в Париже.

rules.body_en: The -ed ending has three sounds. After t or d it is an extra syllable: wanted, needed, visited. After other sounds it is just a short sound: worked, played, lived. Do not say 'work-ed' as two syllables.
rules.body_ru: Окончание -ed произносится тремя способами. После t или d это отдельный слог «-ид»: wanted (уонтид), needed, visited. После остальных звуков это просто короткий звук «т» или «д», без лишнего слога: worked (уоркт), liked (лайкт), played (плейд), lived (ливд). Не читайте worked как «уоркед» — это частая ошибка.

exercises.explain_en: With 'I' the past of 'to be' is 'was'.
exercises.explain_ru: С I прошедшая форма to be — was.

exercises.explain_en: With 'they' the past of 'to be' is 'were'.
exercises.explain_ru: С they прошедшая форма to be — were.

exercises.q: She ___ (work) in a shop last year.
exercises.explain_en: Regular verb: add -ed.
exercises.explain_ru: Правильный глагол: добавляем -ed.

exercises.q: 'Was' is used with I, he, she and it.
exercises.explain_en: Yes. 'Were' is for you, we and they.
exercises.explain_ru: Верно. Were — для you, we, they.

exercises.explain_en: 'Last night' = past: watched.
exercises.explain_ru: Last night — прошлое: watched.

exercises.explain_en: Verb ending in -e: add only -d.
exercises.explain_ru: Глагол на -e: добавляем только -d.

exercises.explain_en: After 'didn't' the verb has no -ed: I didn't work.
exercises.explain_ru: После didn't глагол без -ed: I didn't work.

exercises.q: ___ you at the party? — Yes, I was.
exercises.explain_en: With 'you' we use 'were'. In a question it comes first.
exercises.explain_ru: С you используем were. В вопросе он стоит первым.

exercises.explain_en: Consonant + y: change -y to -ied.
exercises.explain_ru: Согласная + y: меняем -y на -ied.

exercises.explain_en: Past negative: didn't + verb.
exercises.explain_ru: Отрицание в прошедшем: didn't + глагол.

exercises.q: Regular past verbs have the same form for all persons.
exercises.explain_en: Yes: I worked, she worked, they worked.
exercises.explain_ru: Верно: I worked, she worked, they worked — одна форма для всех.

exercises.q: ___ you visit your grandmother? — Yes, I did.
exercises.explain_en: Past question: Did + subject + verb.
exercises.explain_ru: Вопрос в прошедшем: Did + подлежащее + глагол.

exercises.explain_en: One vowel + one consonant: double the consonant: stopped.
exercises.explain_ru: Одна гласная + одна согласная: удваиваем согласную: stopped.

exercises.ru: Вчера меня не было в школе.

exercises.q: There ___ many people at the party.
exercises.explain_en: 'Many people' is plural: there were.
exercises.explain_ru: Many people — множественное число: there were.

exercises.explain_en: Negative: didn't + verb without -ed.
exercises.explain_ru: Отрицание: didn't + глагол без -ed.

exercises.q: 'Ago' goes before the time: 'ago two days'.
exercises.explain_en: 'Ago' comes after the time: two days ago.
exercises.explain_ru: Ago стоит после периода: two days ago («два дня назад»).

exercises.q: Where ___ you live when you were a child?
exercises.explain_en: Question word + did + subject + verb.
exercises.explain_ru: Вопросительное слово + did + подлежащее + глагол.

exercises.q: Was the film good? — No, it ___ .
exercises.explain_en: Negative short answer: No, it wasn't.
exercises.explain_ru: Отрицательный краткий ответ: No, it wasn't.

exercises.answer: She visited Rome two years ago.
exercises.ru: Она была в Риме два года назад.

exercises.q: Did he call you? — No, he ___.
exercises.explain_en: Negative short answer: No, he didn't.
exercises.explain_ru: Отрицательный краткий ответ: No, he didn't.

exercises.q: There ___ (be) a cat in the garden yesterday.
exercises.explain_en: 'A cat' is singular: there was.
exercises.explain_ru: A cat — единственное число: there was.

exercises.q: In 'wanted' the -ed is an extra syllable.
exercises.explain_en: Yes. After 't' or 'd' the -ed sounds like 'id'.
exercises.explain_ru: Верно. После t или d окончание -ed читается как отдельный слог «-ид».

exercises.explain_en: 'My parents' = they, and 'in 2010' is past: were.
exercises.explain_ru: My parents — это they, in 2010 — прошлое: were.

exercises.q: ___ (be) you tired after work? — Yes, I was.
exercises.explain_en: With 'you' the past of 'to be' is 'were'. In a question it comes first.
exercises.explain_ru: С you прошедшая форма to be — were. В вопросе она стоит первой.
